Booking app for service chains

A chain of clinics, salons or car services gets its own app: customers book and prepay, and each specialist runs their schedule on their phone. An MVP in 8–12 weeks, from UZS 144 mln; the full version in 16–26 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Customer app (iOS and Android) with branches, services, specialists and free slots
  • Prepayment with Click or Payme
  • Reminders
  • Schedule app for specialists
  • Admin panel
What the full version adds
  • Memberships and service packages
  • Reviews and ratings
  • Waiting list for cancelled slots
  • Promotions
  • Link to your clinic or POS system
  • Analytics per branch and specialist

What we need from you

  • App Store and Google Play accounts
  • Logo, colours and texts
  • One person who makes the decisions

Questions

What does “Booking app for service chains” cost?
The MVP costs $12,000–24,000 (UZS 144–290 mln), the full version $30,000–65,000 (UZS 360–785 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Booking app for service chains” take?
The MVP takes 8–12 weeks, the full version 16–26 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
App Store and Google Play accounts; Logo, colours and texts; One person who makes the decisions.
